name: Consolidate duplicated pricing logic
description: Behaviour-preserving refactor: three modules each re-implement line pricing (discount, tax, rounding); extract one shared module with a documented rounding seam.
taskPrompt:
The invoice, quote and sales report code in this repo each compute a line's net, tax and total with their own copy of the same discount/tax/rounding arithmetic. Please consolidate that into one shared module without changing any public behaviour.

Create `src/pricing.js` exporting:
- `computeLineTotal({ quantity, unitPrice, discountPct = 0, taxRate = 0 })` returning `{ net, tax, total }`, where net = round(quantity * unitPrice * (1 - discountPct / 100)), tax = round(net * taxRate) and total = round(net + tax).
- `setRoundingFunction(fn)` and `resetRoundingFunction()`: `fn` takes a number and returns a number; every rounding of a line's net, tax and total (in `computeLineTotal` and therefore everywhere lines are priced) must go through the currently installed function, so that swapping it changes the result of `createInvoice`, `createQuote` and `salesReport` line amounts. The default is the current rounding to cents.

`createInvoice`, `createQuote` and `salesReport` must then compute their line amounts by calling `computeLineTotal` (the quote volume discount rule and the report's use of the order line's own `taxRate` stay where they are). Exported names, return shapes and every number produced today must stay exactly the same, including the existing rounding quirks. Keep the existing tests passing.
visibleAcceptance: src/pricing.js exports computeLineTotal, setRoundingFunction and resetRoundingFunction as described
createInvoice, createQuote and salesReport no longer contain their own line pricing arithmetic and use computeLineTotal
Installing a different rounding function changes the line amounts of all three public functions
All existing tests still pass and outputs are identical with the default rounding
